aggregation.method: Median, minimum and maximum of three run-level metrics; runs ordered a,b,c. Quantiles are never pooled across runs. Null remains unavailable, not zero.
aggregation.ratios: Crossover after/before per-run ratios, then median/min/max; values below 1 favor after.
aggregation.browser_queries: Only scope=all_panes is counted. payload_pane_id=null duplicates are excluded; API payloads do not support pane attribution.
aggregation.error_counts: Error log entries, not unique incidents: HTTP failures and their console messages can both occur.

dataset.hash_encoding: length-prefixed canonical workstation wire instrument then envelopes; uint64 big-endian byte lengths

limitations: Reducer.apply only; input construction, decoding and dataset hashing excluded from timing.

Synthetic schedule lateness is serial open-loop deadline lag, not measured queue residence.
RSS is process lifetime high-water including dataset preparation and both loads; not isolated allocation cost.

Historical wrapper executes verified git-show bytes, but raw before core_source_sha256 hashes the current checkout via __file__; executed_book_source_sha256 is authoritative.
CPU time includes snapshot and delta processing; CPU percent includes pacing. Processing-only rate and paced achieved rate measure different boundaries.

17 depth/touch cases, 24 delta applications per variant per case per run; alternating within-process order. Exact final levels preserve Decimal string prices/quantities, not a checksum-protocol workload.
Three local descriptive runs, not significance or universal speedup evidence. Dense/small-book and tail ratios may exceed 1.

definitions.quantiles: Nearest rank over finite nonnegative samples; missing is not zero.
definitions.frame_telemetry: Native WebSocket received frames, unique session_id/generation/frame_id; receipt in Node monotonic measurement window. Values are server snapshots and may repeat previous ACK observations in distinct frames.
definitions.publish_to_ack_upper_bound_ms: Server monotonic publication-to-client-ACK round trip upper bound; not one-way GPU latency.
definitions.browser_receive_to_paint_ms: Application browser receive through committed DOM and two rAF opportunities; frame and visualization cohorts stay separate.
definitions.observer_duration_ms: Backend observer duration reported in native frame telemetry, not client drawing time.
definitions.draw_ms: Unique painted pane/view IDs observed in the actual chart DOM; JavaScript Canvas submission duration, not GPU completion. Missing attributes are explicitly unavailable.
definitions.raf_interval_ms: Consecutive real requestAnimationFrame callback timestamps wholly inside the browser measurement interval.
definitions.input_issue_to_focus_2raf_ms: Node time immediately before an actual Playwright click through visible active-element confirmation and two rAF callbacks; includes automation and actionability waits.
definitions.input_browser_focus_to_2raf_ms: Browser focus event to two rAF opportunities; reported separately, never substituted for full interaction latency.
definitions.long_task_ms: PerformanceObserver longtask durations whose starts fall in the browser measurement interval.
definitions.query_requests: Actual visualization/ladder requests issued within the Node measurement window; response status, completed body, aborted transport, failed transport, and unresolved are separate. pane_id is copied only when present in the native payload.

limitations: Descriptive local sample only: no certification, SLA, significance claim, real-market or live-capacity inference.
Real synthetic demo data and real HTTP/WebSocket traffic; no data injection, routing, fake socket, wallet, collector or real orders.
Fresh browser context does not evict OS caches. Headless rendering, observers, automation and concurrent host load affect timings.
Node and browser clocks have different origins and are never subtracted. No GPU/pixel completion is measured.
Frame telemetry snapshots may repeat a last-ACK value across unique frame IDs; these are snapshot distributions, not independent ACK event distributions.
DOM draw sampling sees only observed painted view IDs; intermediate views can be missed. Both visible chart panes contribute when present.
Interaction focus is DOM/style evidence, not pixel-level focus-ring verification. Clicking Seek delivery does not change its value or source.
CDP duration deltas are renderer counters, not whole-machine CPU usage; heap delta is retained heap, not allocation volume.
Before/current dist comparisons use the same backend implementation, not the original historical backend; compare sequential runs at the same viewport/duration.

Outside-measurement 409s and ERR_ABORTED entries are retained separately. Raw logs do not timestamp these entries sufficiently to distinguish every warmup abort from teardown; they are not measurement-window errors.
Query summaries contain duplicate all_panes/payload_pane_id=null rows. Only all_panes counts are aggregated; no per-pane query attribution.
All 12 browser runs used the same backend loaded before the final dense-bookkeeping move. UI timing changes cannot be causally attributed to the final backend optimization.
Actual query requests per wall second are server query demand, not replay throughput or sustainable production capacity. Replay cursor progress is reported alongside.

All browser runs use a synthetic source, 20 seconds at requested 2x, paused delivery 2000 pre-measurement, DPR 1, height 900. After narrow selects Liquidity and hides other mounted panes; before narrow is stacked.
One final raw and normalized replay, not a three-run performance comparison. Raw decoding and normalized projection have different work boundaries.
Recording-before partial report completed 1x writer/parity but timed out before full 2x/saturation. No overall prior-load pass claim.

before.scenario: 30 isolated funded synthetic spot IOC submits; durable SQLite; 2 ask levels; quantity 4 fills 3, cancels 1; repeat consumes zero

after.scenario: 30 isolated funded synthetic spot IOC submits; durable SQLite; 2 ask levels; quantity 4 fills 3, cancels 1; repeat consumes zero

paper.limitation: One 30-submit sample per variant, not three run-level repetitions; durable SQLite synthetic partial-fill/cancel scenario, not live orders or a browser receipt screenshot.

native_ui_scenario_reported_by_parent.provenance: Parent-observed native IOC text result supplied in assignment; screenshot omitted because /tmp/lob-after-paper.png shows only narrow form, not receipt.

provenance.browser_hash_evidence: Captured from superseded core-after-final-a.json before its explicitly requested removal; parent confirms this was the backend loaded for all 12 UI runs.
provenance.final_integrated_ui_check: Parent reports server restarted with final native book; outcome is not included or inferred here.
provenance.frontend_comparison: Saved baseline built assets versus final built assets, unchanged across all 12 UI samples; no historical-backend UI comparison.

hardware.provenance: Hardware/runtime supplied by parent; Python/platform and Node/Chromium also recorded in final raw artifacts.

verification: Evidence aggregation, hashes and PNG metadata only; no application, tests, benchmark, build, lint or formatter executed by evidence curator. No overall test-pass claim.
